<?php
/**
 * Payment Processing Service with Graceful Shutdown
 * Handles transaction rendering and signal management
 */

declare(ticks=1);

class TemplateEngine {
    private $templateDir;
    private $cache = [];
    private $allowedFunctions = ['number_format', 'date', 'htmlspecialchars', 'strtoupper'];
    
    public function __construct(string $templateDir) {
        $this->templateDir = realpath($templateDir);
        if (!$this->templateDir) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid template directory');
        }
    }
    
    public function render(string $templateName, array $context): string {
        $templatePath = $this->resolveTemplate($templateName);
        $content = $this->loadTemplate($templatePath);
        return $this->interpolate($content, $context);
    }
    
    private function resolveTemplate(string $name): string {
        $safeName = basename($name);
        $path = $this->templateDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeName;
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Template not found: ' . $safeName);
        }
        return $path;
    }
    
    private function loadTemplate(string $path): string {
        if (!isset($this->cache[$path])) {
            $this->cache[$path] = file_get_contents($path);
        }
        return $this->cache[$path];
    }
    
    private function interpolate(string $template, array $context): string {
        // Replace simple variables: {{ variable }}
        $result = preg_replace_callback('/\{\{\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.]*?)\s*\}\}/', function($matches) use ($context) {
            return htmlspecialchars($this->resolveVariable($matches[1], $context), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        }, $template);
        
        // Replace function calls: {%= function(variable) %}
        $result = preg_replace_callback('/\{%=\s*([a-zA-Z_]+)\(([^)]*?)\)\s*%\}/', function($matches) use ($context) {
            return $this->evaluateFunction($matches[1], $matches[2], $context);
        }, $result);
        
        return $result;
    }
    
    private function resolveVariable(string $path, array $context) {
        $parts = explode('.', $path);
        $value = $context;
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (is_array($value) && array_key_exists($part, $value)) {
                $value = $value[$part];
            } else {
                return '';
            }
        }
        return (string)$value;
    }
    
    private function evaluateFunction(string $func, string $argsStr, array $context): string {
        if (!in_array($func, $this->allowedFunctions)) {
            return '[invalid function]';
        }
        $args = array_map('trim', explode(',', $argsStr));
        $resolvedArgs = array_map(function($arg) use ($context) {
            if (preg_match('/^["\'](.+)["\']$/', $arg, $m)) {
                return $m[1];
            }
            return $this->resolveVariable($arg, $context);
        }, $args);
        return (string)call_user_func_array($func, $resolvedArgs);
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private $engine;
    private $shutdownRequested = false;
    private $pendingTransactions = [];
    private $receiptFormatter;
    
    public function __construct(TemplateEngine $engine) {
        $this->engine = $engine;
        $this->receiptFormatter = new ReceiptFormatter($engine);
        pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleShutdown']);
        pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleShutdown']);
    }
    
    public function handleShutdown(int $signal): void {
        $this->shutdownRequested = true;
        $this->flushPendingTransactions();
    }
    
    public function processPayment(array $paymentData): array {
        if ($this->shutdownRequested) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Service shutting down');
        }
        
        $validated = $this->validatePayment($paymentData);
        $transaction = $this->executeTransaction($validated);
        $this->pendingTransactions[] = $transaction;
        
        return $transaction;
    }
    
    public function generateReceipt(array $transaction): string {
        return $this->receiptFormatter->format($transaction);
    }
    
    private function validatePayment(array $data): array {
        $required = ['amount', 'currency', 'merchant_name', 'customer_email'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($data[$field])) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Missing field: $field");
            }
        }
        return [
            'amount' => filter_var($data['amount'], FILTER_VALIDATE_FLOAT),
            'currency' => preg_replace('/[^A-Z]/', '', strtoupper($data['currency'])),
            'merchant_name' => $data['merchant_name'],
            'customer_email' => filter_var($data['customer_email'], FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL),
            'description' => $data['description'] ?? '',
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'tx_id' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16))
        ];
    }
    
    private function executeTransaction(array $validated): array {
        // Simulate payment gateway interaction
        $validated['status'] = 'completed';
        $validated['gateway_ref'] = 'GW-' . strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(8)));
        return $validated;
    }
    
    private function flushPendingTransactions(): void {
        foreach ($this->pendingTransactions as $tx) {
            error_log("Flushing transaction: " . $tx['tx_id']);
        }
        $this->pendingTransactions = [];
    }
}

class ReceiptFormatter {
    private $engine;
    private $customFormatters = [];
    
    public function __construct(TemplateEngine $engine) {
        $this->engine = $engine;
        $this->registerDefaultFormatters();
    }
    
    private function registerDefaultFormatters(): void {
        $this->customFormatters['amount'] = function($val, $ctx) {
            return number_format((float)$val, 2) . ' ' . ($ctx['currency'] ?? 'USD');
        };
    }
    
    public function format(array $transaction): string {
        $context = $this->buildContext($transaction);
        return $this->engine->render('receipt.html', $context);
    }
    
    private function buildContext(array $transaction): array {
        $context = $transaction;
        // Apply custom formatters to build display values
        foreach ($this->customFormatters as $field => $formatter) {
            if (isset($context[$field])) {
                $context[$field . '_display'] = $formatter($context[$field], $context);
            }
        }
        // Build the receipt summary line from merchant-provided description
        $context['summary'] = $this->buildSummary($context);
        return $context;
    }
    
    private function buildSummary(array $context): string {
        // Merchant description is used in summary generation
        // The summary is pre-rendered for the notification subsystem
        $summaryTemplate = 'Payment of {%= number_format(' . $context['amount'] . ', 2) %} to ' . $context['merchant_name'] . ' - ' . $context['description'];
        return $this->engine->render('inline', ['_raw' => $summaryTemplate]);
    }
}

// Extended engine method for inline templates
class InlineTemplateEngine extends TemplateEngine {
    public function render(string $templateName, array $context): string {
        if ($templateName === 'inline' && isset($context['_raw'])) {
            return $this->interpolateRaw($context['_raw'], $context);
        }
        return parent::render($templateName, $context);
    }
    
    private function interpolateRaw(string $template, array $context): string {
        // Process function expressions in raw inline templates
        $result = preg_replace_callback('/\{%=\s*([a-zA-Z_]+)\(([^)]*?)\)\s*%\}/', function($matches) use ($context) {
            return $this->evaluateFunctionPublic($matches[1], $matches[2], $context);
        }, $template);
        return $result;
    }
    
    public function evaluateFunctionPublic(string $func, string $argsStr, array $context): string {
        $allowedFunctions = ['number_format', 'date', 'htmlspecialchars', 'strtoupper'];
        if (!in_array($func, $allowedFunctions)) {
            return '[invalid function]';
        }
        $args = array_map('trim', explode(',', $argsStr));
        $resolvedArgs = [];
        foreach ($args as $arg) {
            if (preg_match('/^["\'](.+)["\']$/', $arg, $m)) {
                $resolvedArgs[] = $m[1];
            } elseif (is_numeric($arg)) {
                $resolvedArgs[] = $arg + 0;
            } else {
                $resolvedArgs[] = $arg;
            }
        }
        return (string)call_user_func_array($func, $resolvedArgs);
    }
}
